promptLatex: What is the minimum number of people that must be in a room to guarantee that at least 3 share the same birthday month?
hintLatex: Use the pigeonhole principle. There are 12 months (boxes).
To guarantee at least 3 people share a birthday month, we need the smallest N such that \lceil N/12 \rceil ≥ 3.
With 25 people and 12 months, by pigeonhole, some month has at least \lceil 25/12 \rceil = \lceil 2.083 \rceil = 3 people.
solutionLatex: By the pigeonhole principle, if N people are placed into 12 months, some month contains at least \lceil N/12 \rceil people.
